productionFileRules: include files under app src/main/java and src/main/resources
include files under every catering-business-server module src/main/java and src/main/resources
include app and module build.gradle.kts task inputs
normalize every path to a repository-relative POSIX path and hash full bytes

entry inventory updates cannot expand W0
